vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s, with a missing fingertip telling A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut about A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The retelling is already better than the event.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a toad like a war drum, throat swelling: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ LaToya, Denise, Mohammed and Natalia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. LaToya, Mohammed, Natalia are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Denise, Natalia, Katarina and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Natalia, Mara are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. The screen burns brightest just before it fires: that's your two-turn warning. Or break its concentration outright: a stun or shout while the screen burns brightest fizzles the picture. Interruptible — it can only hold one memory at a time. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)

📺 You brought down Scarred The Loud Beast. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred The Loud Beast.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Mohammed, Natalia, Mara and Emma met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mohammed, Natalia, Mara, Emma are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Focus Group: Be boring — bore them out of the room. The murmur loves violence one round and is bored by it the next. Be deliberately boring for three rounds — recite bus schedules, count ceiling tiles — and they lose interest and LEAVE. (Striking is entertainment; every swing is a review.) (At the fire, Mohammed told Saul, Natalia, Mara, and 3 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mohammed, Natalia, Emma and Elijah met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Mohammed, Natalia, Emma, Elijah are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (At the fire, Natalia told Denise, Mohammed, Emma, and 1 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Audit: Be inefficient on purpose. It taxes your best trick on audit day — read the clipboard, know the schedule, and front-load everything between the announced rounds. When the auditors come, be deliberately, visibly inefficient: it cannot tax what does not optimize. (At the fire, Zoe told Denise, Mohammed, Natalia, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Terms of Service: Read the fine print — find the loophole. Clauses write themselves and unanswered ones auto-accept, the penalties landing unread. Spend turns examining the scroll and you will find the loophole clause that dismisses it outright. (Striking the scroll just gives it more to bill you for.) (At the fire, Natalia told Denise, Mohammed, Mara, and 4 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Landlord: Never end on leased ground. Rent comes due every round you end on leased ground — keep moving and the ledger starves. Each ADDENDUM raises the rent and heals it. Never end two rounds on the same dirt. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Mohammed, Mara and Elijah met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Mohammed, Mara, Elijah are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Reunion: Do something you have never done. It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. Do something you have never done and it has nothing to wear. Novelty is literally the weapon; repetition is the uniform it dresses you in. (Brian lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Brian told Wei and Mara how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (Brian lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Brian told Wei and Mara how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Eulogy: Contradict the narration. It is a STORY and stories need listeners — it narrates you faltering, and the verses count down. Contradict it with your actions: it says you run, you advance. Three true contradictions and the story dismisses you kindly. (It says you falter — do not.) (At the fire, Marthe told Natalia, Mohammed, Elijah, and 2 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
🛡️ Marthe met them at the door — 1 put down. Marthe is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hemi just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (At the fire, Hemi told Natalia, Mohammed, Elijah, and 2 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Strike: Meet one demand — buy a quiet round. The demands are honest and the schedule is announced. Meet ONE demand — do the work yourself, manually, at real cost — and the picket stands down a round. (Scabbing buys the breather; the strike does not end.) (Zenon lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Zenon told Mohammed and Hemi how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Herald: Read the omens — reposition freely. It announces everything — read the omens. It is slow: reposition freely, never trade blows standing still. (It is a tutorial — the real test comes later. Learn it here, cheap.) (Ivan lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🗣️ Ivan told Hemi and Mohammed how it went — they were there when it happened.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Influencer: Kill the followers first. The followers sharpen the Ratio — every one of them is damage. Kill the followers and it is just a person with good lighting. (Ratio-ing it is a popularity contest; starving its audience is a plan.) (At the fire, Ivan told Zenon, Mohammed and Ruth how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
